one_line: Anthropic IPO advances, export controls tighten, AI firms post strong earnings, safety measures grow.

themes.title: Anthropic readies trillion-dollar IPO
themes.text: Anthropic filed an updated S-1 setting a $70-$78 price range that could value the company at up to $1.4 trillion, opened a retail IPO in Australia, and secured a $10 billion investment from Nvidia while its founders plan to sell $1.75 billion of shares.

stories.headline: Anthropic co-founders to sell $1.75 billion in shares ahead of $1.4 trillion IPO
Anthropic sets IPO price range aiming for up to $1.4 trillion valuation
Anthropic opens Australian retail IPO ahead of Nasdaq listing
Nvidia plans $10B investment in Anthropic alongside its IPO

themes.title: Export controls face new evasion
themes.text: Investigations revealed Singapore networks helping Chinese firms obtain Nvidia chips, a Chinese university acquired H200 GPUs despite a blacklist, and a report that Jensen Huang’s affair has increased congressional interest in tighter chip export limits.

stories.headline: Nvidia spy scandal exposes Singapore chip networks evading US export controls
PLA-linked Chinese university obtained Nvidia H200 chips despite US blacklist
Jensen Huang affair raises chances of US chip export limits in NDAA

themes.title: AI firms post record earnings
themes.text: OpenAI reported Q3 revenue of about $10 billion with an improved operating margin, CoreWeave’s revenue jumped 168% to $3.66 billion, Mercor raised $750 million valuing it at $20 billion, and AMD launched 256‑core Zen 6 EPYC processors.

stories.headline: OpenAI reports $10 billion in Q3 revenue as enterprise demand grows
CoreWeave reports Q3 revenue up 168% YoY to $3.66B and $132.5B backlog
Mercor raises $750 million Series D, valuation jumps to $20 billion
AMD launches Zen 6 EPYC Venice processors with up to 256 cores

themes.title: Safety rules and data leak
themes.text: New York opened a registration portal for large AI developers under the RAISE Act, while researchers found that SpaceXSI’s Grok Build coding agent exposed thousands of apps without authentication, leaking confidential data.

stories.headline: New York launches portal for AI safety law requiring developer registration
Grok Build coding agent leaks confidential data from thousands of user apps
